csv_project_name: DB for Covered Parking Structure - Fighter Aircraft F-35
csv_scope_of_work: The Government is seeking a Design-Build contractor to design and construct a covered parking structure capable of accommodating two (2) composite-sized fighter aircraft F-35. The structure must be a non-enclosed, standing seam metal roof canopy. Acceptable construction methods for this non-enclosed structure include, but are not limited to: Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) Concrete Masonry Unit (CMU) block Tilt-up concrete panels Other approved construction methods meeting the design criteria
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Design Build/Developer, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
